provenance: Semantic-only controls regenerated in the native reference application on September 20, 2026. Native drawing geometry, text rectangles and fonts are independent assertions. Browser Arial glyph measurements drive fitting. Verified saved unique IDs, declaration counts, and authored nonnumeric attributes (allowing omission of default op=none and val=0); the native reference application rounds some numeric layout attributes when saving, so fixtures retain the original full-precision input that produced the native drawing. Covers strict 100-fold interval selection, feasibility before the strict finite endpoint test, 20-doubling budget, finite full-interval fallback, unbounded zero-height reset with retained text, local and parent heights, LIN/COMPOSITE, reference factor rules, and height fitting independently of word width before font reduction, including equal-font members with independent heights. Failed parent allocation retries and self-height bound precedence, and narrow shared-height ordering remain separate open issues and are not included as complete-layout matches.
